crossRefs.note: Yahweh visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. The child Samuel grew before Yahweh.
Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to…
The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.
And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: The child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with Yahweh and also with men.
translations.bsb: And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor with the LORD and with man.
translations.kjv: And the child Samuel grew on, and was in favour both with the LORD, and also with men.
translations.asv: And the child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with Jehovah, and also with men.
